extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: A novel dataset featuring human-crafted instructions that require context-sensitive reasoning for text-rich images, covering eight real-world scenarios.
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were sourced from six different sources: LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative, InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA. Authors then created instruction-response pairs for these images.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative, InfographicVQA, STVQA, ESTVQA
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual filtering for Time, Shopping, Navigation, and Abstract categories. Heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR for Application Usage, Web Usage, Infographic, and Miscellaneous Natural Scenes (selecting top 500 images with highest number of words).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Authors were divided into two groups to annotate images with instruction-response pairs. Stage 1: Shortlisting images. Stage 2: Annotation by author groups. Stage 3: Verification by MTurk workers (96% correct), filtering incorrect samples, and cross-review by author groups.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: MTurk workers verified the correctness of each sample, finding 96% were annotated correctly. Incorrect samples were filtered out.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Release a subset of 100 samples as a validation set with reference responses, keeping the remaining 406 hidden. Continuously updated leaderboard on HuggingFace.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset evaluates context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning, which powers real-world applications like assisting the visually impaired. There is awareness that models can generate harmful responses or hallucinate, though no apparent harmful/privacy info was observed in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Annotators were mainly from the US, so linguistic diversity and writing style of human responses would change with different social groups.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset size is 506 samples. Models struggle with time-related data and infographics. Open models lag behind proprietary ones. Lack of precise visual perception and hallucinations in models.
